org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.business

Class ProcedureOutputMgmt

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.business.ProcedureOutputMgmt

  • public class ProcedureOutputMgmt
extends Object
    Session EJB managing procedure output data. Handles encoding and decoding of values based on procedure output field metadata.

    smichaels

    • Method Detail

      • createProcedureOutput

        public ProcedureOutputable createProcedureOutput(ProcedureOutputable procedureOutput,
                                        Long procedureId)
                                          throws Exception
        Creates a procedure output by traversing all the data in the passed procedureOutput The method calls getOutputFieldClassNames() and getOuputFieldMapForClass(String) to traverse the data by class and then encodes each field using that field's ProcedureOutputField metadata. Each field is then persisted as a ProcedureOutputValue
        Parameters:
        procedureOutput - the procedure output data
        procedureId - the procedure to associate with the data
        Throws:
        Exception

      • findProcedureOutput

        public ProcedureOutput findProcedureOutput(Procedure procedure)
                                    throws Exception
        Generates a procedure output by querying all the ProcedureOutputValue data associated with the procedure output list. The procedure output list is the list of output fields defined for the procedure type. The method calls decodeAndSetObjectFieldValue(Object, FieldDescriptor, String) to reconstitute the data structure This method handles all procedure iteration outputs as well.
        Parameters:
        procedure - the procedure to query and generate output data structure for
        Throws:
        Exception

        public String encodeObjectFieldValue(Object object,
                            Method method,
                            FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor)
                              throws Exception
        Encodes a field value for the passed object and returns the encoded string
        Parameters:
        object - the object containing the data value

        fieldDescriptor - the field descriptor that determines the encoding method to use
        Returns:

      • decodeAndSetObjectFieldValue

        public void decodeAndSetObjectFieldValue(Object classInstance,
                                FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor,
                                String value)
                                  throws Exception
        Decodes a passed value using the passed field descriptor to determine the decoding method to use. Sets the field value in the passed classInstance using the setter method defined by the field name in the field descriptor.
        Parameters:
        classInstance - the object to set the decoded value into
        fieldDescriptor - the field descriptor of the data
        value - the encoded data
        Throws:
        Exception
